deficiencies.title: No.1 lifeboat aft hook reset indicator stiff
deficiencies.description: During the weekly inspection the aft on-load release hook reset indicator was found stiff and did not align cleanly with the reset mark. The gear was reset by hand and the boat was left in the stowed position. The annual thorough examination is also overdue.
deficiencies.correctiveAction: Authorised provider to attend at Rotterdam to examine and overhaul the release gear together with the overdue annual thorough examination. Boat not to be used for a manned drill until cleared.
deficiencies.sparePartRequired: Neptune NLR-60 hook cam and pin set

deficiencies.title: A deck stair enclosure fire door hooked open
deficiencies.description: The A-60 self-closing door to the A deck stair enclosure was found hooked open with a lashing. The hook was removed. On test the door closes but the closer is weak and the door does not latch reliably from the fully open position.
deficiencies.correctiveAction: Hook removed and crew briefed. Ship's staff to adjust or renew the door closer; spare closer requested from the office.

deficiencies.title: Fixed CO2 system two-yearly content check overdue
deficiencies.description: The two-yearly content check of the fixed CO2 system is overdue. The last weighing report on board is from the previous service. The system is otherwise in order: the release cabinet is sealed, the pilot lines are connected and the pre-discharge alarm operated on test.
deficiencies.correctiveAction: Service firm booked to attend at Rotterdam to weigh the cylinder bank and issue the report. Note the flag applies a minimum charge percentage — see the FLAG section before accepting any cylinder.
